title: MV/MZ Better Loading Screen - Plugin to make the original loading screen better

posts.author: TenDev
posts.body:
Better Loading screen (V1.0)
Created by: TenDev
​
Introduction
This plugin allow you to change the original RPG Maker loading screen to another using template of others.
Features
It will overwrite the original loading screen with the one you wish to use.
How to Use
How to install any plugin to RPG Maker MV/MZ
How to use Better Loader Plugin by Ten
Plugin Commands / Script Calls
Plugin Commands:
- Ten_cssLoaders Show        → Show the loader
- Ten_cssLoaders Hide        → Hide the loader
============================================================================
Script Calls:
- Ten_cssLoaders.show();     // Show the loader using JavaScript
- Ten_cssLoaders.hide();     // Hide the loader using JavaScript
Download
[PLUGIN] Better Loader - RPG Maker MV by Tendev2d 's Plugins - RPG Maker MV
A simple plugin to enhance scene loading for RPG Maker MV projects.
tendev2d.itch.io
Terms and Credits
Can be used for free or commercial game projects, just credited TenDev in the game.

sell this plugin.
